note: English A2 reading rounds in the Cambridge A2 Key format (owner's plan 2026-10-30: each language's own exam). Parts 1–5 (6 notices / messages, 7 questions on three texts, a long text × 5, a multiple-choice cloze × 6, an open cloze × 6 with typed one-word answers, en_open). Three options. Original texts. Drafted in tools/.mockups/en_a2.py (rounds 2–3: en_a2_r23.py).

s: Two months ago, I moved out of my parents' house.
I wanted to be more independent, so I rented a small apartment near my office.
paragraphs.zh: 兩個月前，我從爸媽家搬了出來。我想更獨立一點，所以在公司附近租了一間小公寓。

s: It has only one bedroom, but the living room is bigger than my old bedroom.
The rent is not cheap, so I have stopped eating out every weekend.
paragraphs.zh: 它只有一間臥室，但客廳比我以前的臥室還大。房租不便宜，所以我已經不再每個週末都去外面吃飯了。

s: Living alone is harder than I expected.
Nobody cooks for me or reminds me to take out the trash.
Last week I forgot, and the kitchen smelled terrible.
paragraphs.zh: 一個人住比我想像中難。沒人幫我煮飯，也沒人提醒我倒垃圾。上週我忘了倒，廚房臭得要命。

s: Still, I love my new home.
Next month I'm going to paint the walls light blue and invite my parents for dinner.
paragraphs.zh: 不過，我還是很愛我的新家。下個月我打算把牆漆成淺藍色，再請爸媽來吃晚餐。

glossary.en: able to live without help from others
to pay money to live in a place; that money

mcq.q: Why did the writer move out?
options: Her parents asked her to leave
She wanted to be more independent
She found a new job far away
Her old room was too small
mcq.zh: 「I wanted to be more independent」：想更獨立。

mcq.q: What is true about the living room?
options: It is bigger than her old bedroom
It is smaller than the kitchen
mcq.zh: 「the living room is bigger than my old bedroom」。
mcq.en: "The living room is bigger than my old bedroom."

mcq.q: What has she stopped doing?
mcq.zh: 房租不便宜，所以不再每個週末外食。
mcq.en: The rent is not cheap, so she has stopped eating out every weekend.

mcq.q: What happened last week?
options: She forgot to take out the trash
mcq.zh: 「Last week I forgot」：忘了倒垃圾，廚房很臭。
mcq.en: She forgot the trash, and the kitchen smelled terrible.

mcq.q: What is she going to do next month?
mcq.zh: 「I'm going to paint the walls light blue」。
mcq.en: "I'm going to paint the walls light blue."

tf.s: The apartment is near her office.
She thinks living alone is easy.
She wants to have dinner with her parents in her new home.
tf.en: True: she will invite them for dinner.

s: When I was a child, my grandmother made chicken soup every Sunday.
The whole family sat at her big table and ate together.
paragraphs.zh: 我小時候，奶奶每個星期天都會煮雞湯。全家人圍坐在她的大桌子旁一起吃。

s: Last winter, I caught a bad cold.
I called my grandmother and asked for her recipe.
She laughed and said, "There is no recipe. I just cook."
paragraphs.zh: 去年冬天，我得了重感冒。我打電話給奶奶，向她要食譜。她笑著說：「沒有食譜，我就是這樣煮。」

s: So I visited her, and she taught me in her kitchen.
We cut carrots, onions and potatoes, and we cooked the soup slowly for two hours.
paragraphs.zh: 所以我去找她，她在廚房裡教我。我們切了紅蘿蔔、洋蔥和馬鈴薯，用小火把湯慢慢煮了兩個小時。

s: My soup is not as good as hers yet.
But I have written down every step, and now I make it whenever someone in my family feels sick.
paragraphs.zh: 我的湯還沒有她煮的好喝。不過我把每個步驟都寫了下來，現在只要家裡有人不舒服，我就會煮。

glossary.en: to become sick with a cold
to show someone how to do something
a round vegetable with a strong taste

mcq.q: When did the grandmother make chicken soup?
Why did the writer ask for the recipe?
options: She wanted to open a restaurant
mcq.en: She caught a bad cold last winter.

mcq.q: What did the grandmother say about the recipe?
mcq.zh: 「There is no recipe. I just cook.」
mcq.en: "There is no recipe. I just cook."

mcq.q: How long did they cook the soup?
When does the writer make the soup now?
options: When someone in the family is sick
mcq.zh: 「whenever someone in my family feels sick」。
mcq.en: "Whenever someone in my family feels sick."

tf.s: The family ate together at the grandmother's table.
The soup had fish in it.
tf.zh: ×：是雞湯，放紅蘿蔔、洋蔥和馬鈴薯。
tf.en: False: chicken, carrots, onions and potatoes.

tf.s: The writer's soup is already better than her grandmother's.
tf.en: False: "not as good as hers yet".

s: Last spring, my friend Ben and I spent a week in Tokyo.
It was our first trip to Asia, and we were very excited.
paragraphs.zh: 去年春天，我和朋友班在東京待了一個星期。那是我們第一次去亞洲，非常興奮。

s: On the third day, we wanted to visit a famous temple.
We took the wrong train and got off at a station in a quiet neighborhood.
Our phones had no signal, and we couldn't read the signs.
paragraphs.zh: 第三天，我們想去一座有名的寺廟。結果搭錯車，在一個安靜社區的車站下了車。手機沒有訊號，招牌我們也看不懂。

s: An old man saw our map and smiled.
He didn't speak English, but he walked with us for twenty minutes to the right station.
paragraphs.zh: 一位老先生看到我們的地圖，笑了笑。他不會說英文，但陪我們走了二十分鐘，走到正確的車站。

s: We never reached the temple that day because it was already closed.
But that kind man is my favorite memory of the whole trip.
paragraphs.zh: 那天我們沒去成寺廟，因為它已經關門了。但那位好心的老先生，是我整趟旅行中最難忘的回憶。

glossary.en: to leave a bus or train
a board with words or pictures

mcq.q: How long did they stay in Tokyo?
Why did they get lost?
Why couldn't they use their phones?
options: They left them at the hotel

mcq.q: How did the old man help them?
options: He walked with them to the station
mcq.zh: 陪他們走了二十分鐘到正確的車站。
mcq.en: He walked with them for twenty minutes to the right station.

mcq.q: Why didn't they visit the temple?

tf.s: It was their first trip to Asia.
The old man spoke good English.
The writer remembers the old man best.
tf.zh: ○：「my favorite memory of the whole trip」。
tf.en: True: "my favorite memory of the whole trip".

s: It doesn't often snow in my city, but last January we had the biggest storm in thirty years.
Overnight, almost half a meter of snow fell.
paragraphs.zh: 我住的城市不常下雪，但去年一月我們遇上了三十年來最大的暴風雪。一夜之間，下了將近半公尺的雪。

s: In the morning, the radio said that all the schools were closed.
My little brother jumped out of bed and shouted with joy.
paragraphs.zh: 早上，收音機說所有學校都停課了。我弟弟從床上跳起來，開心得大叫。

s: The buses weren't running, so my father couldn't go to work either.
We spent the day outside.
We built a snowman taller than my brother and had a snowball fight with our neighbors.
paragraphs.zh: 公車停駛，所以我爸爸也沒辦法去上班。我們一整天都待在外面。我們堆了一個比弟弟還高的雪人，還和鄰居打了雪仗。

s: By the evening, we were cold and wet, but very happy.
My mother made hot chocolate for everyone, and we watched a movie together.
paragraphs.zh: 到了傍晚，我們又冷又濕，但非常開心。媽媽幫大家泡了熱可可，我們一起看了一部電影。

glossary.en: very bad weather with strong wind

mcq.q: How often does it snow in the writer's city?
mcq.zh: 「It doesn't often snow in my city」。
mcq.en: "It doesn't often snow in my city."

mcq.q: How did the family learn that schools were closed?
mcq.zh: 「the radio said that all the schools were closed」。

mcq.q: Why didn't the father go to work?
What did they build?
mcq.zh: 堆了一個比弟弟還高的雪人。
mcq.en: A snowman taller than the brother.

mcq.q: What did the mother do in the evening?
mcq.en: She made hot chocolate for everyone.

tf.s: The storm was the biggest in thirty years.
tf.en: True: the biggest in thirty years.

tf.s: The brother was sad about the snow day.
The family stayed inside all day.
tf.en: False: they spent the day outside.

s: During the last year, I started buying almost everything online.
It was easy and fast, and I didn't have to carry heavy bags home.
paragraphs.zh: 過去這一年，我開始幾乎什麼都在網路上買。又簡單又快，也不用把重重的袋子提回家。

s: But soon there were boxes everywhere in my apartment.
Some things looked different from the photos, and many clothes didn't fit.
Sending them back took a lot of time.
paragraphs.zh: 但很快地，我的公寓裡到處都是箱子。有些東西跟照片看起來不一樣，很多衣服也不合身。寄回去花了好多時間。

s: One day I checked my bank account and was shocked.
I had spent twice as much as the year before.
paragraphs.zh: 有一天我查了銀行帳戶，嚇了一跳。我花的錢是前一年的兩倍。

s: Now I have a new rule.
If I want something, I wait three days before I order it.
Usually I forget about it, and I save a lot of money.
paragraphs.zh: 現在我定了一條新規矩：如果想買什麼，先等三天再下單。通常我就忘了，因此省下了很多錢。

glossary.en: a place in a bank where you keep money
something that tells you what to do

mcq.q: Why did the writer like shopping online at first?
What was a problem with the clothes?
What surprised her when she checked her bank account?
options: She had spent twice as much as before
mcq.zh: 花的錢是前一年的兩倍。
mcq.en: She had spent twice as much as the year before.

mcq.q: What is her new rule?
mcq.zh: 「I wait three days before I order it」。
mcq.en: "I wait three days before I order it."

mcq.q: What usually happens after three days?

tf.s: Sending things back was quick.
tf.en: False: it "took a lot of time".

tf.s: Some things looked different from the photos.
The new rule helps her save money.
tf.en: True: "I save a lot of money".

s: Every year, our school has a science fair in March.
This year, my friend Maya and I decided to work together.
paragraphs.zh: 我們學校每年三月都會舉辦科學展覽。今年，我和朋友瑪雅決定一起合作。

s: We wanted to find out which drink is the worst for your teeth.
We put eggshells into cola, orange juice, milk and water for a week, because eggshells are similar to teeth.
paragraphs.zh: 我們想找出哪一種飲料對牙齒最不好。因為蛋殼和牙齒很像，我們把蛋殼分別放進可樂、柳橙汁、牛奶和水裡，泡了一個星期。

s: The results surprised us.
The eggshell in cola turned brown, but the one in orange juice became the softest.
The shells in milk and water didn't change at all.
paragraphs.zh: 結果讓我們很意外。泡可樂的蛋殼變成了褐色，但泡柳橙汁的那個變得最軟。泡在牛奶和水裡的蛋殼完全沒有變化。

s: We didn't win first prize, but the judges liked our clear poster.
Since then, I have drunk much less juice.
paragraphs.zh: 我們沒有得到第一名，不過評審很喜歡我們清楚的海報。從那之後，我果汁喝得少多了。

glossary.en: an event where people show things
the hard outside of an egg
a person who decides who wins

mcq.q: When is the science fair?
Why did they use eggshells?
mcq.en: Because eggshells are similar to teeth.

mcq.q: What happened to the eggshell in cola?
Which drink made the shell softest?
mcq.en: The one in orange juice became the softest.

mcq.q: What did the judges like?

tf.s: The writer did the project alone.
The shell in water didn't change.
tf.en: True: milk and water didn't change them.

tf.s: They won first prize.

s: For five years, I drove to work every day.
The trip was only eight kilometers, but in heavy traffic it often took forty-five minutes.
paragraphs.zh: 五年來，我每天開車上班。路程只有八公里，但遇到塞車常常要花四十五分鐘。

s: Last summer, my car broke down, and the repair was very expensive.
While I was waiting for it, I borrowed my neighbor's bike.
paragraphs.zh: 去年夏天，我的車壞了，修理費非常貴。等車修好的那段時間，我向鄰居借了腳踏車。

s: To my surprise, cycling was faster than driving.
There is a bike lane along the river, so I didn't have to wait at traffic lights.
I got to work in only twenty-five minutes.
paragraphs.zh: 沒想到，騎腳踏車比開車還快。沿著河邊有一條腳踏車道，所以我不用等紅綠燈。只花二十五分鐘就到公司了。

s: I have sold my car now and bought my own bike.
I feel healthier, and I have more money for weekend trips.
paragraphs.zh: 現在我已經把車賣了，買了自己的腳踏車。我覺得身體更健康，週末出遊的錢也更多了。

glossary.en: to take something you will give back
a feeling when something is unexpected
a part of a road for one line of traffic

mcq.q: How far is the writer's trip to work?
Why did he start cycling?
mcq.zh: 車壞了，等修理時借了腳踏車。

mcq.q: Whose bike did he use at first?
Why is cycling faster for him?
options: He doesn't wait at traffic lights
mcq.zh: 沿河有腳踏車道，不用等紅綠燈。
mcq.en: There is a bike lane, so he doesn't wait at lights.

mcq.q: What has he done with his car?
options: He gave it to his neighbor
He still uses it in winter

tf.s: Driving to work often took forty-five minutes.
The car repair was cheap.
Cycling to work takes about twenty-five minutes.

s: Last year, I often felt tired during the day.
I went to bed at midnight, but I usually looked at my phone for another hour.
paragraphs.zh: 去年，我白天常常覺得很累。我半夜十二點上床，但通常還會再滑一個小時的手機。

s: My doctor told me that the light from screens makes it harder to sleep.
She gave me some simple advice.
I should stop using my phone an hour before bed and keep my bedroom dark and cool.
paragraphs.zh: 醫生告訴我，螢幕的光會讓人更難入睡。她給了我一些簡單的建議：睡前一小時不要再用手機，臥室要保持又暗又涼。

s: At first it was difficult.
I put my phone in the kitchen and read a book instead.
After about two weeks, I started falling asleep much more quickly.
paragraphs.zh: 一開始很難。我把手機放在廚房，改成看書。大約兩個星期後，我開始比以前快很多就睡著了。

s: Now I sleep about eight hours every night.
I have more energy at work, and I don't need three cups of coffee anymore.
paragraphs.zh: 現在我每晚睡大約八個小時。上班時更有精神，也不再需要喝三杯咖啡了。

glossary.en: the flat part of a phone or TV
words that tell you what to do

mcq.q: What did the writer do before sleeping last year?
mcq.zh: 還會再滑一個小時的手機。
mcq.en: She looked at her phone for another hour.

mcq.q: According to the doctor, what makes sleeping harder?
mcq.zh: 「the light from screens makes it harder to sleep」。

mcq.q: Where did she put her phone at night?
mcq.zh: 「I put my phone in the kitchen」。
mcq.en: "I put my phone in the kitchen."

mcq.q: When did she start falling asleep more quickly?
How is she different now?
options: She goes to bed at midnight
She has more energy at work
mcq.en: She has more energy at work.

tf.s: The doctor said the bedroom should be dark and cool.
The new habit was easy from the first day.
She still needs three cups of coffee a day.
tf.en: False: she doesn't need them anymore.

items.text:
SWIMMING POOL
The pool is closed for cleaning on Monday morning.
It will open again at 2 p.m.

tr.zh:
游泳池
星期一上午泳池清潔，暫停開放。
下午兩點重新開放。

questions.q: What does the notice say?
options: You can swim on Monday afternoon.
The pool is closed all day on Monday.
questions.zh: 星期一只有上午清潔，「下午兩點重新開放」，所以下午可以游泳。
questions.en: Only the morning is closed; it opens again at 2 p.m.

items.text:
Hi Tom,
I'm sorry I can't come to football practice tonight. My mum needs help in the shop. See you at the match on Saturday!
Leo

tr.zh:
湯姆：
抱歉，我今晚不能去足球練習了。我媽媽店裡需要人幫忙。星期六比賽見！
里歐

questions.q: Why is Leo writing?
options: to ask Tom to help in the shop
to say he will miss practice
to change the time of the match
questions.zh: 「我今晚不能去足球練習了」：他是要說自己不能去練習。
questions.en: "I can't come to football practice tonight."

items.text:
Dear students,
From next week the school library will open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m., Monday to Friday. It will be closed at weekends.

tr.zh:
各位同學：
從下週起，學校圖書館星期一到星期五早上八點到晚上六點開放，週末不開放。

questions.q: From next week, students
options: can use the library on Saturdays.
can go to the library early in the morning.
questions.zh: 圖書館「早上八點」就開了，所以早上可以去；週末不開，也沒有說要六點前還書。
questions.en: It opens at 8 a.m.; it is closed at weekends.

items.text:
Please pay at the counter before you sit down.
Free water is on the table by the door.

tr.zh:
請先在櫃台付款再入座。
門邊的桌上有免費的水。

questions.q: What does the notice say?
options: You can get water without paying.
You must sit down before you order.
The table by the door is free to use.
questions.zh: 「門邊的桌上有免費的水」：喝水不用付錢。
questions.en: "Free water" — no need to pay for it.

items.text:
Grandma,
The bus was late, so I'll be at your house at 5.30, not 5. Can you keep some cake for me?
Love, Mia

tr.zh:
奶奶：
公車晚了，所以我五點半才會到你家，不是五點。可以幫我留一點蛋糕嗎？
米亞

questions.q: What does Mia say?
options: She wants to eat cake at five.
She will arrive later than she planned.
questions.zh: 「五點半才會到，不是五點」：比原來的時間晚。
questions.en: 5.30, not 5: later than planned.

items.text:
LOST!
Small black cat with white feet. Her name is Pepper.
If you see her, please phone Sam on 0794 551 208.

tr.zh:
尋貓！
小黑貓，四隻腳是白色的，名字叫小胡椒。
如果看到她，請打電話給山姆：0794 551 208。

questions.q: What does the notice say?
options: Someone has found a cat called Pepper.
The owner wants people to phone if they see the cat.
questions.zh: 「如果看到她，請打電話給山姆」；貓是走失的，腳是白色的。
questions.en: Phone if you see her; the cat is lost and has white feet.

items.text:
A  Anna
I work in a bookshop on Saturdays. I help customers find books and put new books on the shelves. The best part is that I can read for free in my lunch break. The worst part is that I have to start at eight o'clock, which is early for me.
B  Ben
On Sundays I work at a café near the beach. It gets very busy in summer, and sometimes I work for eight hours without a break! I like meeting tourists from different countries. I'm saving my money for a new bike.
C  Carla
I walk dogs for people in my street on Saturday and Sunday afternoons. I usually walk three dogs at the same time. I love animals, so it doesn't feel like work. When it rains, though, it isn't much fun.

tr.zh:
A 安娜：我星期六在書店工作，幫客人找書、把新書放上架。最棒的是午休時可以免費看書；最糟的是要八點開始上班，對我來說太早了。
B 班：我星期天在海邊的咖啡店工作。夏天很忙，有時候一連工作八個小時都沒休息！我喜歡認識各國來的遊客。我在存錢買新腳踏車。
C 卡拉：我星期六和星期天下午幫街上的鄰居遛狗，通常一次遛三隻。我很喜歡動物，所以不覺得是在工作。不過下雨的時候就沒那麼好玩了。

questions.q: Who works on both days of the weekend?
questions.zh: 卡拉「星期六和星期天下午」都遛狗。
questions.en: Carla works on Saturday and Sunday.

questions.q: Who has to get up early for work?
questions.zh: 安娜「要八點開始上班，對我來說太早了」。
questions.en: Anna starts at eight, early for her.

questions.q: Who is saving money for something?
questions.zh: 班「在存錢買新腳踏車」。
questions.en: Ben is saving for a bike.

questions.q: Who doesn't enjoy the job in bad weather?
questions.zh: 卡拉說「下雨的時候就沒那麼好玩了」。
questions.en: Carla: not fun when it rains.

questions.q: Who gets something free at work?
questions.zh: 安娜「午休時可以免費看書」。
questions.en: Anna reads for free.

questions.q: Who sometimes works for hours without stopping?
questions.zh: 班「有時候一連工作八個小時都沒休息」。
questions.en: Ben works eight hours without a break.

questions.q: Who meets people from other countries?
questions.zh: 班「喜歡認識各國來的遊客」。
questions.en: Ben meets tourists from different countries.

items.text:
My first month in the city
Last month my family moved from a small town to a big city because of my dad's new job. I was worried because I didn't know anyone there. On my first day at my new school, my teacher, Mr Hall, asked a girl called Jess to show me around. She took me to the library, the dining room and the sports hall. At lunch she sat with me and introduced me to her friends. I was surprised that everyone was so friendly.
The city is very different from my old town. There are lots of buses, and now I can go to school on my own, which I couldn't do before. My old school was a ten-minute walk from my house, but now the journey takes thirty minutes by bus. I don't mind, because I read on the bus.
At the weekend Jess invited me to go to the museum with her family. We saw some dinosaur bones and had pizza afterwards. I miss my grandparents, who still live in my old town, but we talk on the phone every Sunday. Next month they are coming to visit us, and I'm going to show them all my favourite places. — Sofia

tr.zh:
我在城市的第一個月
上個月，因為爸爸換了新工作，我們全家從小鎮搬到了大城市。我很擔心，因為那裡我一個人也不認識。到新學校的第一天，霍爾老師請一個叫潔絲的女生帶我參觀。她帶我去了圖書館、餐廳和體育館。午餐時她和我坐在一起，還把她的朋友介紹給我。大家都這麼友善，讓我很驚訝。
城市和我以前住的小鎮很不一樣。這裡公車很多，我現在可以自己去上學，以前是不行的。以前學校離家走路十分鐘，現在坐公車要三十分鐘。我不介意，因為我在車上看書。
週末潔絲邀我和她的家人一起去博物館。我們看了恐龍骨頭，然後去吃披薩。我很想念還住在小鎮的爺爺奶奶，不過我們每個星期天都會通電話。下個月他們要來看我們，我要帶他們去我最喜歡的地方。——蘇菲亞

questions.q: Why did Sofia's family move?
questions.zh: 「因為爸爸換了新工作」。
questions.en: "Because of my dad's new job."

questions.q: How did Sofia feel before her first day?
questions.zh: 「我很擔心，因為那裡我一個人也不認識」：很緊張。
questions.en: "I was worried."

questions.q: What did Jess do at lunch?
options: She showed Sofia the sports hall.
She asked Mr Hall to help.
She introduced Sofia to her friends.
questions.zh: 「午餐時她和我坐在一起，還把她的朋友介紹給我」；參觀體育館不是午餐時。
questions.en: At lunch she introduced Sofia to her friends.

questions.q: What is different about going to school now?
options: Sofia travels on her own by bus.
questions.zh: 「我現在可以自己去上學」，坐公車三十分鐘；走路十分鐘是以前。
questions.en: She goes alone by bus; the ten-minute walk was before.

questions.q: What will Sofia do next month?
questions.zh: 「下個月他們要來看我們，我要帶他們去我最喜歡的地方」。
questions.en: Her grandparents visit and she shows them around.

items.text:
The Robot Café
A new café has opened in the city centre, and it is (19) ＿＿＿＿＿ any other café you have visited. Here, robots bring your food (20) ＿＿＿＿＿ your table. The owner, Lisa Grant, got the idea (21) ＿＿＿＿＿ she was on holiday in Japan. 'People come here because they (22) ＿＿＿＿＿ to see the robots,' she says. 'But they come back because the food is good.' The café is open seven days (23) ＿＿＿＿＿ week, and children under five eat for free. It's a good idea to book a table, (24) ＿＿＿＿＿ the café is often very busy.

tr.zh:
機器人咖啡店
市中心新開了一家咖啡店，和你去過的任何咖啡店都不一樣。在這裡，是機器人把餐點送到你的桌上。老闆麗莎·葛蘭特是在日本度假時想到這個點子的。她說：「客人來這裡是因為想看機器人，但他們會再來，是因為東西好吃。」咖啡店一週七天都營業，五歲以下的孩子免費用餐。最好先訂位，因為店裡常常很多人。

questions.zh: 「unlike any other café」：和其他咖啡店都不一樣。different 要說 different from。
questions.en: unlike any other café; "different" would need "from".

questions.zh: 把東西送「到」某處用 bring … to。
questions.en: bring something to a place.

questions.zh: 「when she was on holiday」：在度假的時候。
questions.en: when she was on holiday.

questions.zh: 「want to see」想看；enjoy 後面接 seeing，look 要用 look at。
questions.en: want to see; enjoy takes -ing.

questions.zh: 「seven days a week」是固定說法：一週七天。
questions.en: seven days a week.

questions.zh: 最好訂位的原因是店裡很多人，用 because。
questions.en: Book because it is busy.

items.text:
Hi Sam,
Thanks (25) ＿＿＿＿＿ your email. I'm writing to tell you about my new hobby. Last month I started (26) ＿＿＿＿＿ the guitar. I have a lesson every Tuesday after school. My teacher is very patient, and she says I am getting better. At the moment I'm learning a song (27) ＿＿＿＿＿ my favourite band. It's quite difficult, but I practise (28) ＿＿＿＿＿ day. Would you like to come to my house next weekend? We (29) ＿＿＿＿＿ play some music together. Let me know (30) ＿＿＿＿＿ you can come!
Max

tr.zh:
山姆你好：
謝謝你的來信。我想告訴你我的新嗜好。上個月我開始學吉他，每個星期二放學後上一堂課。老師很有耐心，她說我越來越進步了。我現在在學我最喜歡的樂團的一首歌，滿難的，不過我每天都練習。下週末要不要來我家？我們可以一起彈點音樂。告訴我你能不能來！
麥克斯

questions.zh: 「Thanks for …」：謝謝某件事，固定用 for。
questions.en: Thanks for your email.

questions.zh: 「start playing / learning the guitar」：開始彈、開始學吉他；start 後面接 -ing。
questions.en: started playing (or learning) the guitar.

questions.zh: 「a song by my favourite band」：某個樂團的歌，用 by（也可以說 from）。
questions.en: a song by (or from) my favourite band.

questions.zh: 「every day」：每天。
questions.en: every day.

questions.zh: 提議一起做某事：「We can / could play …」。
questions.en: We can (could) play some music together.

questions.zh: 「Let me know if you can come」：告訴我你能不能來。
questions.en: Let me know if (whether) you can come.

items.text:
PARK CAFÉ
Open every day, 9 a.m. – 5 p.m.
Dogs welcome at the outside tables only.

tr.zh:
公園咖啡館
每天營業，早上九點到下午五點。
狗狗只能在戶外座位。

questions.q: What does the notice say?
options: You can bring your dog inside.
You can sit outside with your dog.
questions.zh: 狗狗「只能在戶外座位」，所以可以帶狗坐外面。
questions.en: Dogs are welcome at the outside tables.

items.text:
Dad,
I've taken your umbrella because mine is at school. I'll bring it back after my dance class at 7.
Amy

tr.zh:
爸：
我拿了你的雨傘，因為我的放在學校。七點舞蹈課結束後會拿回來。
艾咪

questions.q: Why is Amy writing?
options: to ask for a new umbrella
to say her dance class has changed
to explain where Dad's umbrella is
questions.zh: 她說明自己「拿了你的雨傘」，七點後還。
questions.en: She tells Dad she has taken his umbrella.

items.text:
SALE
All T-shirts half price this weekend.
Shoes: buy one pair, get a second pair free.

tr.zh:
特賣
本週末所有 T 恤半價。
鞋子：買一雙，第二雙免費。

questions.q: What does the notice say?
options: You can get two pairs of shoes for the price of one.
The sale is for one day only.
questions.zh: 「買一雙，第二雙免費」：一雙的價錢買兩雙；T 恤是半價，不是免費。
questions.en: Buy one, get one free; T-shirts are half price.

items.text:
Mr Brown's science class on Wednesday will be in Room 12, not the lab.
Please bring your homework.

tr.zh:
布朗老師星期三的自然課改在 12 號教室，不在實驗室。
請帶作業來。

questions.q: On Wednesday, students should
options: give their homework to Mr Brown on Tuesday.
questions.zh: 「改在 12 號教室，不在實驗室」：換了教室。
questions.en: Room 12, not the lab.

items.text:
Jack,
The concert tickets go on sale on Friday. They sell out fast, so shall I buy yours too? You can pay me later.
Ollie

tr.zh:
傑克：
演唱會的票星期五開賣，很快就會賣光，要不要我也幫你買？錢之後再給我就好。
奧利

questions.q: What does Ollie offer to do?
options: go to the concert on Friday
questions.zh: 「要不要我也幫你買？」：他要幫傑克買票；星期五是開賣日。
questions.en: He offers to buy Jack's ticket.

items.text:
TRAIN PASSENGERS
The 10.15 to Bristol will leave from Platform 4 today.
Please do not use the lift — it is out of order.

tr.zh:
火車旅客請注意
今天 10:15 開往布里斯托的列車在第 4 月台發車。
電梯故障，請勿使用。

questions.q: What does the notice say?
options: The train to Bristol is late.
questions.zh: 電梯「故障，請勿使用」，只能走樓梯；沒有說火車誤點。
questions.en: The lift is out of order.

items.text:
A  Dan
I study at the city library. It's very quiet, and there are big tables where I can put all my books. It's open until nine in the evening, so I go there after school. The only thing I don't like is that you can't eat or drink inside.
B  Ella
I like studying at my grandmother's flat because she makes me tea and cakes. She lives near my school, so I can walk there in five minutes. Her cat sometimes sits on my books, which is funny but not very helpful!
C  Finn
I study in my bedroom with music on. My parents say I can't concentrate with music, but I disagree — it helps me. I've got a desk by the window, and I can see the park. I study best early in the morning, before breakfast.

tr.zh:
A 丹：我在市立圖書館讀書。那裡很安靜，有大桌子可以放我所有的書。開到晚上九點，所以我放學後去。唯一不喜歡的是裡面不能吃東西、喝飲料。
B 艾拉：我喜歡在奶奶的公寓讀書，因為她會幫我泡茶、拿蛋糕。她住在學校附近，我走路五分鐘就到。她的貓有時候會坐在我的書上，很好笑，但沒什麼幫助！
C 芬恩：我在房間裡開著音樂讀書。爸媽說聽音樂沒辦法專心，但我不同意，音樂對我有幫助。我的書桌在窗邊，看得到公園。我在早上吃早餐前讀書效果最好。

questions.q: Who has an animal near them while they study?
questions.zh: 艾拉說奶奶的「貓有時候會坐在我的書上」。
questions.en: Grandma's cat sits on Ella's books.

questions.q: Who studies before eating in the morning?
questions.zh: 芬恩「在早上吃早餐前」讀書。
questions.en: Finn studies before breakfast.

questions.q: Who would like to have a snack while studying?
questions.zh: 丹不喜歡圖書館「不能吃東西、喝飲料」。
questions.en: Dan doesn't like that he can't eat there.

questions.q: Who studies very close to school?
questions.zh: 奶奶住學校附近，艾拉「走路五分鐘就到」。
questions.en: Five minutes from school.

questions.q: Who studies in a public place?
questions.zh: 丹在「市立圖書館」讀書。
questions.en: Dan uses the city library.

questions.q: Whose family doesn't agree with how they study?
questions.zh: 芬恩「爸媽說聽音樂沒辦法專心」。
questions.en: Finn's parents dislike the music.

questions.q: Who goes somewhere that closes in the evening?
questions.zh: 圖書館「開到晚上九點」。
questions.en: The library is open until nine.

items.text:
My summer job at the zoo
Last summer I worked as a helper at Westfield Zoo for six weeks. I wanted the job because I'm planning to study animal science at university. My first job every morning was to clean the penguins' area. It started at seven, so I had to get up at six — not easy for me! After that I helped to prepare food for the animals. The giraffes eat leaves, which we cut from trees in the zoo's garden.
My favourite part of the day was the talk at two o'clock. One of the keepers told visitors about the elephants, and after two weeks she asked me to do it. I was very nervous the first time, but the visitors asked lots of questions, and I enjoyed answering them.
The job wasn't well paid, but I learned a lot. The keepers have invited me to come back next summer, and I've already said yes. — Hannah

tr.zh:
我在動物園的暑期打工
去年暑假，我在西田動物園當了六個星期的小幫手。我想做這份工作，是因為我打算上大學讀動物學。每天早上第一件工作是打掃企鵝區，七點開始，所以我六點就得起床——對我來說可不容易！之後我幫忙準備動物的食物。長頸鹿吃樹葉，是我們從動物園花園的樹上剪下來的。
我一天中最喜歡的是兩點的解說。一位飼育員會向遊客介紹大象，兩週後她請我來講。第一次我非常緊張，但遊客問了很多問題，我很喜歡回答。
這份工作薪水不高，但我學到很多。飼育員邀我明年暑假再回來，我已經答應了。——漢娜

questions.q: Why did Hannah want the job?
options: It will help with her future studies.
questions.zh: 她「打算上大學讀動物學」；薪水其實不高。
questions.en: She plans to study animal science; the pay was low.

questions.q: What was difficult for Hannah?
questions.zh: 「六點就得起床——對我來說可不容易」。
questions.en: Getting up at six was not easy.

questions.q: What did the giraffes eat?
questions.zh: 樹葉「是從動物園花園的樹上剪下來的」。
questions.en: Leaves cut from the zoo's trees.

questions.q: How did Hannah feel the first time she gave the talk?
questions.zh: 「第一次我非常緊張」。
questions.en: She was very nervous.

questions.q: What will Hannah do next summer?
questions.zh: 飼育員邀她回來，「我已經答應了」。
questions.en: She has agreed to come back.

items.text:
The Longest Bike Ride
Last year, a sixteen-year-old boy called Sam Price rode his bike (19) ＿＿＿＿＿ the north of Scotland to the south of England. The journey (20) ＿＿＿＿＿ him three weeks. He slept in tents and small hotels, and his dad drove a car behind him (21) ＿＿＿＿＿ the food and clothes. Sam did the ride (22) ＿＿＿＿＿ collect money for a children's hospital. He hoped to get £1,000, but people gave him (23) ＿＿＿＿＿ than £5,000! 'I was tired every day,' Sam says, '(24) ＿＿＿＿＿ I'd love to do it again.'

tr.zh:
最長的單車之旅
去年，一個叫山姆·普萊斯的十六歲男孩，騎單車從蘇格蘭北部騎到英格蘭南部。這趟旅程花了他三個星期。他睡帳篷和小旅館，爸爸開車跟在他後面，載著食物和衣服。山姆騎這一趟是為了替一家兒童醫院募款。他原本希望募到一千英鎊，結果大家捐了超過五千英鎊！山姆說：「我每天都很累，但我很想再騎一次。」

questions.zh: 「from … to …」：從某地到某地。
questions.en: from the north … to the south.

questions.zh: 「The journey took him three weeks」：花了他三週；spent 的主詞要是人。
questions.en: It took him three weeks; "spent" needs a person as subject.

questions.zh: 開車跟著，車上「帶著」食物和衣服：with。
questions.en: drove … with the food and clothes.

questions.zh: 表示目的「為了募款」：to + 原形動詞 collect。
questions.en: to collect: purpose.

questions.zh: 後面有 than，用比較級「more than」。
questions.en: more than £5,000.

questions.zh: 很累「但」還想再騎：前後相反，用 but。
questions.en: Tired, but he wants to do it again.

items.text:
Hi Jo,
I'm (25) ＿＿＿＿＿ holiday in Spain with my family at the moment. We're staying in a small hotel near (26) ＿＿＿＿＿ beach. The weather is hot and sunny, so we go swimming every morning. Yesterday we visited an old castle. It was (27) ＿＿＿＿＿ interesting, but there were lots of steps! Tonight we're going (28) ＿＿＿＿＿ eat at a fish restaurant. I've bought you a present, but I won't tell you what it is. (29) ＿＿＿＿＿ you doing anything fun this week? Write soon and tell me (30) ＿＿＿＿＿ your news!
Kate

tr.zh:
裘你好：
我現在和家人在西班牙度假。我們住在海灘附近的一家小旅館。天氣又熱又晴朗，所以我們每天早上都去游泳。昨天我們參觀了一座古堡，很有意思，不過階梯好多！今晚我們要去一家海鮮餐廳吃飯。我買了禮物給你，但不告訴你是什麼。你這週有做什麼好玩的事嗎？快回信，把你的近況都告訴我！
凱特

questions.zh: 「on holiday」：在度假，固定用 on。
questions.en: on holiday.

questions.zh: 名詞 beach 前要加冠詞：near the beach。
questions.en: near the beach.

questions.zh: 形容詞前加程度副詞：very / really interesting。
questions.en: very (really, quite) interesting.

questions.zh: 「be going to + 原形動詞」：打算做某事。
questions.en: we're going to eat.

questions.zh: 現在進行式問句：Are you doing …?
questions.en: Are you doing anything fun?

questions.zh: 「tell me all your news」或「tell me about your news」。
questions.en: tell me all (about) your news.

items.text:
LIBRARY
You can borrow up to six books for three weeks.
DVDs: one week only.

tr.zh:
圖書館
書最多可以借六本，借期三週。
DVD：只能借一週。

questions.q: What does the notice say?
options: DVDs must come back sooner than books.
Books must be returned after one week.
questions.zh: DVD 只能借「一週」，書是三週，所以 DVD 要早點還。
questions.en: DVDs: one week; books: three weeks.

items.text:
Hi Gran,
Thank you for the birthday money! I'm going to spend it on a new phone case and some art pencils. Can I come and show you on Sunday?
Lily

tr.zh:
奶奶好：
謝謝您給的生日紅包！我要用來買新的手機殼和一些美術色鉛筆。星期天可以去給您看嗎？
莉莉

questions.q: Why is Lily writing?
options: to ask for money for a phone
to invite Gran to her party
to thank Gran for a present
questions.zh: 開頭就是「謝謝您給的生日紅包」。
questions.en: To thank Gran for the birthday money.

items.text:
SPORTS CENTRE
Yoga classes are now on Tuesday evenings instead of Monday.
The price is the same.

tr.zh:
運動中心
瑜伽課從星期一晚上改到星期二晚上。
價格不變。

questions.q: What does the notice say?
options: Yoga classes have moved to a different day.
There are no more yoga classes on Tuesday.
questions.zh: 「改到星期二晚上」：換了日子；價格不變。
questions.en: Moved from Monday to Tuesday; same price.

items.text:
Max,
I'm at the dentist until 4. Your dinner is in the fridge — just put it in the microwave for two minutes.
Mum

tr.zh:
麥克斯：
我在看牙醫，四點才結束。你的晚餐在冰箱裡，放進微波爐熱兩分鐘就好。
媽媽

questions.q: What does Max need to do?
questions.zh: 「放進微波爐熱兩分鐘」：要把飯熱一熱；看牙醫的是媽媽。
questions.en: Microwave his dinner; Mum is at the dentist.

items.text:
FOR SALE
Girl's bike, blue, 2 years old. Perfect for ages 8–11.
£40 or best offer. Call Helen after 6 p.m.

tr.zh:
出售
女童腳踏車，藍色，用了兩年，適合 8 到 11 歲。
40 英鎊，可議價。晚上六點後請打給海倫。

questions.q: What does the notice say?
options: You should phone in the evening.
questions.zh: 「晚上六點後請打給海倫」；車用了兩年，價格可議。
questions.en: Call after 6 p.m.; the price can change.

items.text:
Students: please do not leave bags in the corridor. Use your lockers.
Bags in the corridor will be taken to the office.

tr.zh:
同學們：請勿把書包放在走廊，請使用置物櫃。
放在走廊的書包會被拿到辦公室。

questions.q: What does the notice say?
options: Bags left in the corridor will be moved.
Students must take their bags to the office.
There are no lockers for students.
questions.zh: 放在走廊的書包「會被拿到辦公室」：會被移走。
questions.en: They will be taken to the office.

items.text:
A  Grace
Every Saturday morning I go to a cooking club at the community centre. We learn to make food from different countries — last week it was an Indian curry. We eat everything we cook at the end, so I never need lunch afterwards! It costs £5 each time.
B  Harry
I'm in a chess club that meets on Sunday afternoons in a café. Most of the members are older than me — some are over seventy! — but they're very kind. I've won three games this month. The club is free, but we all buy a drink from the café.
C  Isla
I go to a climbing club at an indoor wall in the town centre. We meet on Saturday and Sunday mornings. I was scared at first, but now I can climb to the top. Next month the club is going to a real mountain in Wales, and I can't wait.

tr.zh:
A 葛蕾絲：我每個星期六早上去社區中心的烹飪社。我們學做各國的菜，上週是印度咖哩。最後會把做的東西全部吃掉，所以之後我都不用吃午餐！每次五英鎊。
B 哈利：我參加一個西洋棋社，星期天下午在一家咖啡館聚會。大部分社員都比我大，有些超過七十歲！但他們人很好。這個月我贏了三盤。社團免費，不過大家都會跟咖啡館買一杯飲料。
C 艾拉：我參加市中心一間室內攀岩場的攀岩社，星期六和星期天早上都有聚會。一開始我很害怕，現在已經能爬到頂了。下個月社團要去威爾斯爬真正的山，我等不及了。

questions.q: Who is going on a trip with their club soon?
questions.zh: 艾拉的社團「下個月要去威爾斯爬山」。
questions.en: Isla's club goes to Wales next month.

questions.q: Who doesn't have lunch after their club?
questions.zh: 葛蕾絲說「之後我都不用吃午餐」。
questions.en: Grace never needs lunch afterwards.

questions.q: Who is younger than most people in their club?
questions.zh: 哈利說「大部分社員都比我大」。
questions.en: Most members are older than Harry.

questions.q: Who goes to their club twice a weekend?
questions.zh: 艾拉「星期六和星期天早上」都去。
questions.en: Isla goes on Saturday and Sunday.

questions.q: Whose club doesn't cost anything?
questions.zh: 哈利的「社團免費」，只是自己買飲料。
questions.en: Harry's club is free.

questions.q: Who learns about food from abroad?
questions.zh: 葛蕾絲「學做各國的菜」。
questions.en: Grace cooks food from different countries.

questions.q: Who was frightened when they started?
questions.zh: 艾拉「一開始我很害怕」。
questions.en: Isla was scared at first.

items.text:
The day I met my favourite writer
I have loved Rosa Grey's books since I was eight. Last spring my aunt read on the internet that Rosa was coming to a bookshop in our town to sign her new book. I didn't believe it at first, because she lives in Canada and doesn't often travel.
On the day, my aunt and I arrived an hour early, but there was already a long line outside the shop. We waited for two hours! When it was finally my turn, I was so excited that I forgot what I wanted to say. Rosa smiled and asked me which of her books I liked best. I told her it was The Silver Door, and she wrote a message to me in my copy of it.
Now I'm writing my own story, about a girl who finds a secret garden. Rosa told me to write a little every day, and that's what I do. — Ben

tr.zh:
我見到最喜歡的作家的那一天
我從八歲就喜歡蘿莎·葛雷的書。去年春天，我阿姨在網路上看到蘿莎要來我們鎮上的書店幫新書簽名。一開始我不相信，因為她住在加拿大，很少出遠門。
那天我和阿姨提早一小時到，可是店外已經排了長長的隊。我們等了兩個小時！終於輪到我時，我興奮到忘了要說什麼。蘿莎笑著問我最喜歡她哪一本書。我說是《銀色的門》，她就在我那本書上寫了一段話給我。
現在我在寫自己的故事，講一個女孩發現秘密花園。蘿莎叫我每天寫一點，我也真的這樣做。——班

questions.q: How did Ben find out about the event?
options: He saw a poster in the bookshop.
His aunt read about it online.
Rosa Grey sent him an email.
questions.zh: 「我阿姨在網路上看到」。
questions.en: His aunt read about it on the internet.

questions.q: Why was Ben surprised?
options: His aunt liked the books too.
Rosa Grey does not often leave her country.
questions.zh: 「她住在加拿大，很少出遠門」。
questions.en: She lives in Canada and rarely travels.

questions.q: What happened when Ben met Rosa?
options: He couldn't remember what to say.
He gave her a copy of his story.
She asked him to read aloud.
questions.zh: 「我興奮到忘了要說什麼」。
questions.en: He forgot what he wanted to say.

questions.q: Where did Rosa write a message?
options: in Ben's copy of The Silver Door
questions.zh: 他說最喜歡《銀色的門》，她「在我那本書上」寫給他。
questions.en: In Ben's copy of The Silver Door.

questions.q: What advice did Rosa give Ben?
questions.zh: 「蘿莎叫我每天寫一點」。
questions.en: Write a little every day.

items.text:
Penguins
Penguins are birds, but they cannot fly. (19) ＿＿＿＿＿, they are excellent swimmers. Some penguins can swim (20) ＿＿＿＿＿ fast as 35 kilometres an hour. Most penguins live in the south of the world, and many of them live in very cold places. They have thick feathers (21) ＿＿＿＿＿ keep them warm. Penguins eat fish, which they (22) ＿＿＿＿＿ catch under the water. A mother penguin usually lays one or two eggs, and the father often (23) ＿＿＿＿＿ care of them. Today some kinds of penguin are in danger, (24) ＿＿＿＿＿ the seas are getting warmer.

tr.zh:
企鵝
企鵝是鳥，但不會飛。不過牠們很會游泳，有些企鵝每小時能游到三十五公里。大部分企鵝住在地球南邊，很多住在非常冷的地方。牠們有厚厚的羽毛保暖。企鵝吃魚，會在水裡抓魚。企鵝媽媽通常下一到兩顆蛋，常常由企鵝爸爸照顧蛋。現在有些種類的企鵝面臨危險，因為海水越來越暖。

questions.zh: 不會飛，「不過」很會游泳：前後對比，用 However。
questions.en: Contrast: however.

questions.zh: 「as fast as …」：快到……的程度。
questions.en: as fast as.

questions.zh: 指前面的 feathers（東西），關係代名詞用 which。
questions.en: feathers which keep them warm.

questions.zh: 「can catch」：能抓；are / have 後面不能直接接原形動詞。
questions.en: they can catch.

questions.zh: 「take care of」：照顧，固定用 take。
questions.en: takes care of them.

questions.zh: 海水變暖是企鵝有危險的「原因」：because。
questions.en: because the seas are warmer.

items.text:
Dear Mr Lee,
I am writing (25) ＿＿＿＿＿ ask about the summer art course. My friend did it last year, and she said it was great. I would like to know how much it costs and (26) ＿＿＿＿＿ long each class is. I am fourteen years old, and I have been painting (27) ＿＿＿＿＿ I was ten. Is the course for people of my age? Also, do I need to bring (28) ＿＿＿＿＿ own paints and brushes, or (29) ＿＿＿＿＿ you give them to students? I hope to hear from you (30) ＿＿＿＿＿.
Yours sincerely,
Ruby Ford

tr.zh:
李先生您好：
我寫信是想詢問暑期美術課程。我朋友去年上過，她說很棒。我想知道費用多少，以及每堂課多長。我今年十四歲，從十歲就開始畫畫。這個課程適合我這個年紀嗎？另外，我需要自己帶顏料和畫筆，還是你們會提供給學生？希望很快收到您的回覆。
敬上
露比·福特

questions.zh: 「I am writing to ask …」：寫信的目的，to + 原形動詞。
questions.en: writing to ask.

questions.zh: 「how long」：多長時間。
questions.en: how long each class is.

questions.zh: 現在完成進行式 + 「since I was ten」：從十歲起。
questions.en: since I was ten.

questions.zh: 「my own paints」：我自己的顏料。
questions.en: my own paints.

questions.zh: 一般問句：do / will you give …?
questions.en: do (will, can) you give them?

questions.zh: 「hear from you soon」：很快收到回覆，信件常用結尾。
questions.en: hear from you soon.
